name: Ship It
summary: A commit-readiness workflow for non-trivial UAF work.

combo.description: Commit-readiness combo: sync, objective tests, opposite-brand review, and final UAF check.

phases.title: Generated Instruction Sync
phases.action: Check generated agent files before claiming the repo is ready.
phases.stop_condition: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are in sync.

phases.title: Default UAF Check
phases.action: Run the default UAF structural verifier. Replace this phase with a project test verifier when one is configured.
phases.verifier: The UAF structural verifier records a passed verification event.

phases.title: Opposite-Brand Adversarial Review
phases.action: Use the opposite reviewer brand to challenge the finished slice before commit.
phases.command: uaf adversarial-review --from codex --brand {{combo_brand}} --mission {{mission_id}} --scope "<scope>" --prompt "Review this completed slice for blockers, false rigor, missing tests, and unsafe UAF state changes." --profile {{profile}} --timeout-ms 1800000
phases.verifier: Review is recorded, blockers are repaired, and orchestrator decision is accepted.

phases.title: Final UAF Check
phases.action: Run UAF structural validation after review and repairs.
phases.stop_condition: Repo state is structurally valid and ready for commit.
